 ORDER 1. Heard.
Perused the case diary.
2. This is a repeat (Third) application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been implicated in connection with Crime No.340/2023, registered at Police Station - Banganga, District - Indore, (M.P.), for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366,
376(1), 342 and 506 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: liberty
to file fresh application after examination of the prosecutrix before the trial Court vide order dated 12.07.2023
. Second application bearing M.Cr.C. No.40387/2023 was dismissed on merit vide order dated 31.10.2023.
The applicant is in custody since 14.03.2023.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that at the time of the incident, the prosecutrix was 14 years 7 months of age, was living with her parents at Ganeshdham Colony Indore in a rented house of present applicant Ajay.
Therefore, the prosecutrix and the applicant were known to each other.
The applicant used to tell the prosecutrix that he loves her and wants to marry her.

On 25.02.2023, the applicant had told the prosecutrix to go alongwith co- accused Rajpal, a friend of present applicant on his motorcycle on 27.02.2023 and the applicant will come along as well and marry her.

Due to abetment by the applicant, on 27.02.2023, the prosecutrix, at 04:00 PM met co-accused Rajpal in front of her house from where the co-accused Rajpal took her to Dewas and kept her in a room of hotel.

At night,
co-accused Rajpal committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
As she tried to flee away, she was threatened by the co- accused Rajpal.
On 28.02.2023, co-accused took the prosecutrix to Indore from Dewas by motorcycle and had left her at Railway Station.

On the same day, at around 4:45 PM,
the police recovered the prosecutrix from GRP P/S at Railway Station Indore.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has not committed any offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.

After dismissal of Second bail application of the applicant on 31.10.2023 the prosecutrix has been examined before the trial Court but she has not levelled any allegation against the applicant in respect of rape.
In her deposition the main accused is Rajpal.
It is also submitted that applicant has no criminal antecedents.
He is in custody since 14.03.2023.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal.
On these grounds prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
5. Per contra, learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prays for rejection of the application.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
